verses.text: Ese ukuntu igisagara gisigaye ari umusaka, kera cahora cuzuye abantu! Ese ukuntu kimeze nk’umupfakazi, kandi kera cahora gihambaye mu mahanga! Cahora kimeze nk’umwamikazi mu zindi ntara ariko ubu cabaye nk’umugurano.
Mw’ijoro gicunduguta amosozi, akagitemba ku matama. Mu bahora bagikunda bose nta n’umwe wo kugihoza. Abagenzi baco bose baragihemukiye; bahindutse abansi baco.
Amaze kugira amarushwa menshi n’ugucumukura, Yuda yajanywe ari inyagano. Ubu aba hagati mu mahanga, nta buragamo afise na mba. Abamuhiga bose baramushikiriye bamusanze mu mubabaro mwinshi.

Amayira aja i Siyoni aragandaye, kuko ata muntu n’umwe akija mu misi mikuru yashinzwe. Amarembo yaho yose aripfumbereje, abaherezi baho baraniha, abagore baho bakiri bato barababaye kandi hari ukwihebura kurenze urugero.
Abamugwanya basigaye ari bo bamuganza; abansi biwe baguwe neza. Uhoraho yamuzanyeko imibabaro kubera ivyaha vyiwe vyinshi. Abana biwe bose batwawe nk’inyagano, bacitse imbohe imbere y’abansi babo.
Ubwiza bwose bwaraheze ubwahora ku mukobwa w’i Siyoni. Abaganwa baho bameze nk’impongokazi yabuze aho irisha; kubera intege nke zabo bakuye hasi barahunga imbere y’uwabahiga.

Mu misi y’umubabaro waho no kuburanirwa Yerusalemu hibutse ubutunzi bwose hari hafise mu misi ya kera. Igihe abantu baho bagwa mu maboko y’umwansi, ntihabonetse n’umwe wo kubatabara. Abansi baho ubu baraharaba bakitwengera babonye uburyo hasambuwe.
Yerusalemu hakoze ivyaha vyinshi ni co catumye hahumana. Abahora bahubaha ubu barahakengera, kuko babonye ubwambure bwaho; ubwaho haraniha hihindukiza.

Ubuhumane bwaho buhomye ku vyambarwa hambaye; ntihiyumviriye kuri kazoza kaho. Ukugwa kwaho kwabaye ugukomeye; kandi nta n’umwe wo kuhagarukirako. “Yewe Uhoraho , raba umubabaro wanje, kuko umwansi yanesheje.”
Umwansi yasahuye ubutunzi bwaho bwose; habonye abanyamahanga batubaha Imana binjira mu Ngoro, abo wari warihanije ngo ntibaze binjire mw’ikoraniro ryawe.
Abantu baho bose baraniha kuko barondera ico barya; batanga ubutunzi bwabo ngo baronke ivyokurya bashobore kuzigama ubuzima. “Ewe Uhoraho , raba kandi wongere witegereze, ukuntu nkengerewe.”
“Mbega mwebwe murengana nta co bibabwiye? Nimuhindukire hirya no hino murabe. Mbega hari ukubabazwa guhwanye n’uku kwanje ukwo nahawe n’ Uhoraho , ku musi w’uburake bwiwe bw’inkazi?
Yarungitse umuriro ari iyo hejuru, awurungika mu magufa yanje. Yagaranzuye urusenga rufata amaguru yanje maze ansubiza inyuma. Yansize ndi umusaka, kandi nguma mu mubabaro rikarinda rirenga.

Ivyaha vyanje yabiboheye hamwe bicika ingogo, yavyegeranishije ukuboko kwiwe. Vyaraje bishika no kw’izosi ryanje kandi Imana yatumye inkomezi zanje zisambuka. Yandekuriye mu maboko y’abo ntashobora no guhagarara imbere.

Imana yaranse abagwanyi banje bose bari kumwe nanje; yahamagariye ingabo zose kungwanya kugira ngo bamene umutwe abasore banje. Imana yahonyanze Umukobwa w’i Buyuda, nka kurya baganira umuvinyu mu bwato.
Ni co gituma ndira amaso yanje akaba yuzuye amosozi. Kandi nta n’umwe ari hafi wo kumpoza nta n’umwe wo kuremesha impwemu yanje. Abana banje bakuweho kuko umwansi yaturushije inkomezi.”
I Siyoni hamanitse amaboko, ariko nta n’umwe yabonetse wo kuhahoza. Kw’itegeko ry’ Uhoraho , ababanyi ba Yakobo bamuhindukiye abansi; i Yerusalemu habahindukiye nk’ikintu gihumanye hagati muri bo.
“ Uhoraho aragororotse, ariko nagararije ivyo yategetse. Nimwumve, yemwe mahanga mwese; nimurabe umubabaro wanje. Abasore banje n’inkumi zanje bajanywe nk’inyagano.
Natumyeko abakunzi banje ariko barampemukiye. Abaherezi banje n’inararibonye zanje bahoneye mu gisagara mu gihe bariko bararondera indya ngo barabe ko boba barabayeho.

Raba, yewe Uhoraho , ingene ndi mu magorwa! Muri jewe nuzuye uruhagarara, kandi mu mutima ndahungabanye, kuko nabaye umugarariji arushirije. Hanze, inkota yampekuye abana banje; mu nzu na ho ni urupfu gusa.
Abantu bumvise ukuniha kwanje, ariko nta n’umwe wo kumpoza. Abansi banje bose bumvise amagorwa yanje; banezererwa ivyo wakoze. Ndakwinginze ngo ubashitseko wa musi wavuga ngo na bo bamere nkanje.
Ivyo bagabitanije vyose nibije imbere yawe; ubakorere nk’ivyo wankoreye kubera ivyaha vyanje. Ukuniha kwanje ni kwinshi kandi umutima wanje ucitse intege.”

Ese ukuntu Imana yatwikirije umukobwa w’i Siyoni igicu c’uburake bwayo! Yahomvoreye hasi ubwiza bwa Isirayeli, ibukura mw’ijuru ibukororera mw’isi; ntiyibutse indava y’ibirenge vyayo ku musi w’uburake bwayo.
Imana yamize miyonzwa imihana ya Yakobo; mu burake bwayo yasubije hasi ahazitijwe inzitiro z’umukobwa w’i Buyuda. Kandi ubwami bwaho n’abaganwa baho yabisenyuriye hasi biri mu biteterwe.

Mu burake bwayo bw’inkazi yavunye ihembe ryose ry’Abisirayeli. Yakuyemwo ukuboko kwayo kw’i buryo igihe umwansi yari yegereje. Mu ba Yakobo yatse kurya kw’umuriro utongora uturira ibintu vyose biri i ruhande yawo.
Yafoye umuheto wiwe nk’umwansi, ukuboko kwiwe kw’i buryo kuriteguye. Yabaye nk’umwansi mu kwica abantu bose b’igikundiro; yasutse uburake bwiwe nk’umuriro kw’ihema ry’umukobwa w’i Siyoni.
Imana yabaye nk’umwansi; yamize Isirayeli atamuhekenye. Yamize adahekenye ibirimba vyaho asenyurira hasi inyubako zaho zikomeye. Yagwije ikigandaro n’ugucura intimba ku mukobwa w’i Buyuda.

Yasambuye aho yaba hahinduka agahinga, yasambuye ikibanza ciwe c’amakoraniro. Uhoraho yatumye i Siyoni hibagira imisi mikuru yategekanijwe yaho n’amasabato; mu bushangashirwe bwiwe yakengereye umwami n’umuherezi.

Uhoraho yashiburiye kure igicaniro ciwe yahevye ahera hiwe. Inzitiro z’ibirimba vyiwe yabirekuriye mu maboko y’umwansi; bavugirije akamo mu Ngoro y’Imana nk’uko vyahora mu gihe c’umusi mukuru washinzwe.

Uhoraho yahisemwo gusambura uruzitiro rukikije umukobwa w’i Siyoni. Yagoroye umugozi wo gupima kandi ntiyabujije ukuboko kwiwe ngo ntigusambure. Yahinduye impome n’inzitiro agacurantimba; vyose vyahindutse umusaka.

Amarembo yaho yasenyukiye hasi; ibihindizo vyayo vyaravunaguwe birasamburwa. Umwami waho n’abaganwa bacitse inyagano mu mahanga, nta vyagezwe bikiriho, kandi abavugishwa baho ntibakibona ivyo berekwa bivuye k’ Uhoraho .
Inararibonye z’umukobwa w’i Siyoni zicaye hasi, ntibakurako umunwa; bisuriye umukungugu ku mitwe bambara amagunira. Abakobwa b’i Yerusalemu bunamitse imitwe yabo mw’ivu.
Amaso yanje ananiwe no kurira, muri jewe huzuye uruhagarara, umutima wanje usutswe hasi kw’isi kuko abantu banje basanganguwe, kuko abana n’inzoya bapfira mu mabarabara yo mu gisagara.
Babwira ba nyina bati: “Umukate n’umuvinyu biri hehe?” mu gihe bariko bararaba nk’abakomeretse mu mabarabara y’igisagara, maze ubuzima bukabavamwo bari mu maboko ya ba nyina.

Mbega mvuge iki kuri wewe? Mbega nokugereranya n’iki, ga yewe mukobwa w’i Yerusalemu? Nogushushanya n’iki, kugira ngo nshobore kukuremesha, ga yewe mukobwa w’i Siyoni? Igikomere cawe gishika kure nk’ikiyaga. None ni nde yogukiza?
Ivyo abavugishwa bawe beretswe vyari ibinyoma bitagira akamaro; ntibakweretse icaha cawe ngo bigukize kujanwa uri inyagano. Ivyo bavugishijwe imbere yawe vyari ibinyoma bizimiza.
Abaca aho uri bifata ku munwa; bakavuza agahwa bazunguza imitwe ku bw’umukobwa w’i Yerusalemu bati: “Iki ni ca gisagara citwa ubwiza busumba ubundi bwose, umunezero w’isi yose?”
Abansi bawe bose barasamye kandi basamira wewe; bavuza agahwa bagahekenya amenyo bavuga bati: “Twamumize tutamuhekenye. Uyu ni wa musi twari turindiriye; twabayeho ngo tuwubone.”
Uhoraho yakoze ivyo yari yarateguye; yashikije ijambo ryiwe, iryo yari yaravuze kera. Yaragusambuye ata kagongwe, yatumye umwansi anezererwa ivyago vyawe, yashize hejuru ihembe ry’abansi bawe.
Imitima y’abantu itakambira Imana. Yewe nzitiro z’umukobwa w’i Siyoni, amosozi yawe nacuncubuke nk’uruzi ku murango no mw’ijoro; kandi nturuhuke, n’amaso yawe ntaruhuke.
Va hasi, boroga mw’ijoro, abateramyi bagitangura; suka umutima wawe nk’amazi imbere y’Imana. Mumutarikire ibiganza kubera ubuzima bw’abana banyu, baraba kubera inzara ku mpande zose z’amabarabara.
“Raba, yewe Uhoraho , kandi ubibabare: Ni nde wigeze ugirira nk’ibi? Mbega abagore borya abana bivyariye, abana birereye? Abaherezi n’abavugishwa bokwicirwa mu Ngoro y’Imana?
Abana n’abakuze barambaraye hamwe mu mukungugu wo mu mabarabara; abasore banje n’abigeme bishwe n’inkota. Wabasogose ku musi w’uburake bwawe; ubacumita ata kagongwe.

Nk’uko utumira abantu ku musi mukuru, ni ko watumiye abaza kuntera ubwoba impande zose. Ku musi w’uburake bwawe nta n’umwe yashoboye guhunga canke ngo asigare; abo nivyariye nkabirerera, umwansi wanje yarabariritse.”
Ndi umuntu yabonye imibabaro bivuye ku nkoni y’uburake bw’ Uhoraho .
Yantwaye kure atuma ngendera mu mwijima atari mu muco;
ni ukuri, ukuboko kwiwe kwahindukiriye kungwanya, kwongera kwisubiriza, rikarinda rirenga.
Yatumye urukoba rwanje n’umubiri wanje bisaza kandi yavunaguye amagufa yanje.
Yaranyugarije ankikiza umururazi n’ingorane.
Yampaye kuba mu mwiza nk’abapfuye kera.
Yanyubakiye uruzitiro ngo sinshobore guhunga; yambohesheje iminyororo.
Mbere n’iyo ntakamvye canke ngatabaza nsaba uwomfasha, yugaranira hanze ugusenga kwanje.
Yugarishije inzira yanje ibihongo vy’amabuye; yatumye inzira zanje zigoramanga.
Nk’idubu riryamira kwica, nk’intambwe ibunda irindiriye ico ifata,
ni ko yankuye mu nzira arantabagura, ansiga ntagira gitabara.
Yafoye umuheto wiwe antumberezako imyampi yiwe.
Yatobekeranishije umutima wanje imyampi akuye mu bubiko bwiwe.
Nahindutse ikiyago c’abantu banje bose iyo bagomba kuba baratwenga; bantwengera mu ndirimbo zabo rikarinda rirenga.
Yangaburiye ivyatsi birura, anywesha ibirura cane.
Amenyo yanje yayahongoje kurya urucekeri rw’amabuye; yantsindagiye mu mukungugu.
Yarambujije kuronka amahoro; nibagiye icitwa gutera imbere.
Maze ndavuga nti: “Ubwiza bwanje buraheze hamwe n’ivyo nari niteze k’ Uhoraho vyose.”
Nibuka umubabaro wanje no kwama nangara, kwama ku mururazi n’uburozi.
Ndavyibuka vyose neza, umutima wanje ukadendebukirwa.
Ariko ibi ni vyo nibuka bikantera ivyizigiro:
Ni uko kubera urukundo ruhambaye rw’ Uhoraho tutazoherengetezwa, kuko imbabazi ziwe zamaho ibihe vyose.
Zama ari nsha uko bukeye; ubwizigirwa bwawe buratangaje.
Ndibwira muri jewe nti: “ Uhoraho ni we mugabane wanje; ni co gituma nzomwitega.”
Uhoraho agirira neza abamwiteze, abamurondera bose;
ni vyiza kwitega ducereje agakiza k’ Uhoraho .
Ni vyiza ko umuntu yikorera ingogo igihe akiri muto.
Niyicare wenyene acereje, kuko Uhoraho yayimuremetse.
Niyubike mu maso hiwe, kuko kumbure haracariho ivyizigiro.
Natege umusaya wiwe uwuwukubita, yuzure ibiteterwe.
Kuko Imana atawe iheba burundu.
Naho ateza umubabaro, azogira ikigongwe, urukundo rwiwe rwinshi rwamaho.
Kuko atazana imibabaro abishaka canke ngo ababaze umuntu n’umwe.
Gufyonyorera musi y’ibirenge imbohe zose zo mu gihugu,
kwima abantu uburenganzira bwabo imbere y’Iyisumbavyose,
kurenganya umuntu mu rubanza, mbega Imana ntizobibona?
Ni nde yovuga ibintu bikaba Imana itari yo yabitegetse?
Mbega si mu kanwa k’Iyisumbavyose hava ivyago n’ivyiza?
None ni igiki gituma umuntu yidodomba nimba ahaniwe ivyaha vyiwe?
Nimuze twisuzume turabe inzira zacu, maze tugaruke k’ Uhoraho .
Dutarikire imitima yacu n’amaboko yacu Imana yo mw’ijuru, tuvuge tuti:
“Twaragucumuyeko turakugarariza nawe ntiwatubabariye.
Witwikiriye uburake, maze uradukinagiza; utwica ata kagongwe.
Wipfutse igicu kugira ngo ugusenga ntikugushikire.
Waduhinduye nk’umwavu n’agakengerwe mu mahanga.
Abansi bacu bose buguruye akanwa kabo cane mu kutugwanya.
Twabaye mu mibabaro itewe n’ubwoba no gutsindwa, imisaka no gusangangurwa.”
Imigende y’amosozi itemba iva mu maso yanje kuko ubwoko bwanje buranduwe.
Amaso yanje azorira ubudahengeshanya, ata guhozwa,
kugeza Uhoraho aravye kw’isi ari mw’ijuru akabibona.
Ivyo mbona binzanira umubabaro mu mutima kubera abagore bo mu gisagara cacu.
Ababaye abansi banje ata nyanduruko, bampiga nk’inyoni.
Bagerageje kunsuka mu cobo maze bandundako amabuye;
amazi yarandengeye ku mutwe, maze ndihebura ko nzimanganye.
Nambaje izina ryawe, yewe Uhoraho , ndi i bwina bw’icobo.
Wumvise ugutaka kwanje: “Ntiwugare amatwi ngo ureke kwumva ugutakamba kwanje ndondera ugutabarwa.”
Waregereye igihe nagutakambira, maze uvuga uti: “Ntutinye.”
Ewe Mana, wafashe mu minwe urubanza rwanje; wacunguye ubugingo bwanje.
Ewe Uhoraho , wabonye ibibi nagiriwe. Ncira urunkiza!
Wabonye uburyo bagomba kunyihora, wabonye imigabo yose bangiriye.
Yewe Uhoraho wumvise ibitutsi vyabo, n’inama bangira zose,
ivyo abansi banje bongorerana bakagabira kuri jewe rikarenda rirenga.
Barabe! Bicaye canke bahagaze, bavuga amajambo y’agahemo mu mvyino zabo zose.
Basubirize mu nkoko ivyo bakwiranye, yewe Uhoraho , ku vyo amaboko yabo yakoze.
Shira uruhumyi ku mitima yabo, kandi umuvumo wawe ube kuri bo!
Ubakurikire mu burake bwawe maze ubaherengeteze musi y’amajuru y’ Uhoraho .
Ese ukuntu inzahabu yacuye, inzahabu nziza yataye ubwiza bwayo! Amabuye y’urusengero yandagaye hasi mu mayira no mu mpande zose.
Ese ukuntu abahungu beza b’i Siyoni, bahora baremereye nk’inzahabu, ubu bameze nk’inkono z’ibumba, igikorwa c’amaboko y’umubumvyi!
N’imbwebwe zironsa mu kugaburira ivyana vyazo, ariko abantu banje babaye abatagira umutima bameze nk’ikinyoni citwa otirishe mu bugaragwa.
Kubera inyota ururimi rw’uruhinja rwafatanye n’amagage; abana barasega umukate, ariko nta n’umwe abaha na mba.
Abahora barya ibishwashwagira bishwe n’inzara mu mayira. Abakuze bambara impuzu z’inyambarabami ubu barara ku magunira y’imyavu.
Igihano c’abantu banje kirengeye ic’ab’i Sodomu, bamwe barandurwa mu kanya isase ata wo kubatabara.
Abaganwa baho barera derere kurusha shelegi mbere barera kurusha n’amata, imibiri yabo yari ikomeye nk’amabuye, mu maso habo basa n’ibuye ry’agaciro ryitwa lapisi lazuli.
Ariko ubu barirabura kurusha umwijima w’umuzitanya; mu nzira nta wushobora kubamenya. Urukoba rwabo rwafatanye n’amagufa yabo; rwarumye nk’inkoni.
Abicwa n’inkota bapfa neza kuruta abicwa n’ikigoyi. Kubera gusonza, barapfa bishwe no kubura ivyokurya vyo mu mirima.
Abagore, naho bagirira impuhwe abana babo, barabatetse n’amaboko yabo, maze barabarya igihe abantu banje bariko barahona.
Uhoraho yadusutseko uburake bwiwe bwose; yarekuye uburake bwiwe bwaka nk’umuriro. Yadometse umuriro i Siyoni uturira amatanguriro yaho.
Abami bo mw’isi ntibavyizera, canke umuntu n’umwe wo mu baba kw’isi, ko abansi n’abakeba boshobora kwinjira amarembo y’i Yerusalemu.
Ariko vyashitse kubera ivyaha vy’abavugishwa b’aho n’ukugabitanya kw’abaherezi b’aho, bahasheshe amaraso y’abagororotsi.
Bagendagenda mu mayira y’aho nk’abantu b’impumyi. Bahumanijwe n’amaraso ku buryo ata n’umwe yubahuka gukora no ku mpuzu zabo.
Abantu barasemerera bati: “Igirayo! Murahumanye!” “Nimuje kure! Nimuje kure! Ntimudukoreko!” Bariko barahunga bangara, abantu bo mu mahanga bavuga bati: “Ntibagikwiye kuguma hano na gatoya.”
Uhoraho ubwiwe ni we yabasabagije; ntakiri umwungere wabo. Abaherezi ntibacubahwa, n’inararibonye ngo zigirirwe akagongwe.
Vyongeye, amaso yacu yaruhijwe no kwitega ugutabarwa kandi kutari buboneke; twarerekeye ku minara yacu turaba ihanga ritashobora kudutabara.
Abantu baguma bareretse intambuko zacu zose, kubera ivyo ntitwacaruka ngo tugendagende mu mabarabara iwacu. Iherezo ryacu ryari hafi, imisi yacu yari iharuwe, kuko iherezo ryacu ryari rishitse.
Abaduhiga banyaruka nk’inkona mu kirere; badukinagiza ku misozi kandi batubundiye mu bugaragwa.
Uwasizwe amavuta n’ Uhoraho , ari we ubugingo bwacu bwenenako, yafashwe n’imitego yabo. Twiyumvira ko musi y’igitutu ciwe ari ho tuzoba turi mu mahanga.
Nezerwa kandi uhimbarwe, yewe mukobwa w’i Edomu, wewe uba mu gihugu c’i Uzi. Ariko na wewe igikombe cawe kizoza; uzoborerwa, ute impuzu ugende gusa.
Igihano cawe kizohera, yewe mukobwa w’i Siyoni; ntazokwongereza igihe cawe co kuba mu kinyago. Ariko azohana ivyaha vyawe, wewe mukobwa w’i Edomu, agaragaze ububi bwawe.
Wibuke, yewe Uhoraho , ivyatubayeko; raba, ubone ibiteterwe turimwo.
Ishamvu yacu yahawe abo tutazi, amazu yacu yahawe abanyamahanga.
Twahindutse impfuvyi zitagira ba se, kandi ba mama babaye abapfakazi.
N’amazi yo kunywa turayagura; n’inkwi ducana tuzironka dutanze amahera.
Abadukinagiza badufashe ku gakanu; turaremerewe, nta gahengwe dufise.
Twunamiye Egiputa na Ashuri kugira ngo turonke ivyokurya tubeho.
Ba sogokuruza bacu baracumuye kandi ntibakiriho, ariko twikoreye igihano cabo.
Abagurano ni bo batuganza, kandi nta n’umwe wo kudukura mu maboko yabo.
Turonka ivyokurya mu guheba amagara yacu kubera inkota iri mu bugaragwa.
Urukoba rwacu rurashushe nk’itanure, kubera ubushe bw’inzara.
Abagore bafashwe ku nguvu i Siyoni, n’abakobwa mu bisagara vy’i Buyuda.
Abaganwa bamanitswe n’amaboko yabo; inararibonye ntizicubahwa.
Abasore baruhishijwe n’ibikorwa vyo gusya; abahungu badandabiranishwa n’imiganda y’inkwi.
Inararibonye zavuye kw’irembo ry’igisagara; abasore bahagaritse kuririmba.
Umunezero wose waragiye uva mu mitima yacu; intambo zacu zahindutse ikigandaro.
Urugori rwarakorotse ruva ku mutwe wacu. Turagowe, kuko twacumuye!
Ni ku bw’ivyo imitima yacu icitse intege, ni ku bw’ivyo amaso yacu atakibona neza,
kuko umusozi Siyoni wabaye imisaka, wabaye ikirimbiro ry’imbwebwe.
Wewe Uhoraho , uraganje ibihe bidashira; ingoma yawe izokwamaho uko urunganwe ruzokurikirana n’urundi.
Mbega ni kuki wama utwibagira? Ni kuki waduhevye igihe kingana uku?
Utugarukane kuri wewe, yewe Uhoraho , natwe turagaruka; udusubize imyaka yacu ya kera,
kiretse nimba waraduhevye ibihe vyose, ukaba waraturakiye birenze urugero.
